copy.caption: Full day-by-day itinerary in the first comment. Twenty-seven days from Auckland, from Beijing and Xi'an through a Yangtze River cruise, Chengdu, Guilin and Hangzhou to Shanghai. Return international and domestic flights, 4-5 star hotels, the 5-star Victoria Yangtze River Cruise, an English-speaking tour guide and the 50 meals listed in the itinerary are in the price. From NZD $10,899 per person, twin share; single supplement NZD $2,555. Travel insurance and tips are not included.
